title: MZ Help finding a Tactical Battle system

posts.author: Aria_Mooncrest
posts.body: Does anyone know where to find a tactical battle system similar to Disgaea or phantom brave?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Welcome! What have you tried? I Googled "rpg maker mz tactical plugin" and several things come up immediately. You're not going to find anything that specifically duplicates features from those games like carrying people or...whatever you do in Phantom Brave
I would give you this suggestion: this is very far from what RPG Maker is intended to do. That means plugins for this are pretty technical and complex.
There are other game-making engines designed to make SRPGs which might save you a lot of work; and if you really do want to use RPG Maker for it, you'd do well to spend some time doing tutorials and making practice games using the default engine before trying to modify it so heavily.

posts.author: Magenta-Fantasies
posts.body:
I'm working on a tactical RPG called Outcasts of the Rift and I use SRPG Gear MZ. This plugin is still being actively maintained, and as a bonus, it's free.
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...s-for-creating-tactical-battle-system.153483/
It has a high learning curve, but that is true of any tactical RPG plugin I've seen. I'd say SRPG Gear MZ is the most robust of these plugins and has the most features.
It also depends on the type of tactical RPG you want to make and what you want the gameplay to be like. To use examples I'm familiar with, do you want the gameplay of your game to be more like Fire Emblem or Final Fantasy Tactics? Outcasts of the Rift is somewhere in between (though definitely erring more on the "Fire Emblem" side.) SRPG Gear is geared (no pun intended) towards more Fire Emblem-esque tactical RPGs. Once I saw a paid tactical RPG plugin that was very similar to Final Fantasy Tactics, but I can't remember the name of it or who made it.
